description: This file contains timezone utility functions for managing timezone data, including loading timezone databases, converting positions, handling timezone aliases, and managing timezone location data.

classes.name: TzDB
classes.description: Structure representing the timezone database, including locations and backward alias mappings.

classes.name: TzLocation
classes.description: Structure representing a timezone location with country, zone, comment, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: TzInfo
classes.description: Structure holding timezone information such as name and offset.

methods.name: tz_load_db
methods.description: Loads timezone data from a file, parses locations, sorts them, and loads backward timezone aliases.

methods.name: tz_location_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a TzLocation object.

methods.name: tz_db_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a TzDB object, including its locations and backward alias table.

methods.name: tz_get_locations
methods.description: Returns the list of timezone locations in the database.

methods.name: tz_location_get_country
methods.description: Returns the country of a timezone location.

methods.name: tz_location_get_zone
methods.description: Returns the zone name of a timezone location.

methods.name: tz_location_get_comment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with a timezone location.

methods.name: tz_location_get_position
methods.description: Retrieves the longitude and latitude of a timezone location.

methods.name: tz_location_get_utc_offset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset for a given timezone location.

methods.name: tz_info_from_location
methods.description: Creates a TzInfo object based on a timezone location, setting environment variables to determine local timezone info.

methods.name: tz_info_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a TzInfo object.

methods.name: tz_info_get_clean_name
methods.description: Returns a cleaned and possibly alias-resolved name for a timezone, based on the database's backward alias table.
